incidents.title: Assistant quoting out-of-date rates
incidents.root_cause: CHG-0417 changed Penny's prompt and went live without independent validation. The new prompt dropped the rule that the assistant may only answer from retrieved content, so it began quoting last year's mortgage and savings rates from memory.
incidents.fix: CHG-0421 rolled back the prompt after validation, 20 Aug.

incidents.title: Credit declines citing applicant's ZIP code
incidents.root_cause: LendScore v4.2 (CHG-0409) was validated for accuracy, but its new area-default-rate feature leaked into the reason codes, so some decline notices told applicants their neighbourhood counted against them. That is a fair-lending proxy for race and national origin.
incidents.fix: CHG-0412 suppressed the geographic reason code and re-ranked reasons, 12 Aug.
